subject.title: WhatsApp QR-unavailable/headless login needs phone-code fallback

question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic channel login contract and `openclaw channels login --phone-number`, or should the fallback stay on a WhatsApp-owned surface?
rationale: The requested fix is useful but not only an implementation detail: the active PRs expand public CLI/plugin auth surface and change persisted WhatsApp auth-state classification.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
options.body: Keep the typed generic phone-number login path, but require QR compatibility, partial-credential cleanup, focused tests, and live plus upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep The Surface WhatsApp-Owned
options.body: Rework the fallback so phone-code login is exposed by the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause Until Live Dependency Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open while waiting for stronger Baileys phone-code and 515 recovery proof before committing to a public entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the typed generic phone-number login path, but require QR compatibility, partial-credential cleanup, focused tests, and live plus upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the newer maintainer-authored candidate PR and recent merged history in the WhatsApp auth/session lifecycle area.
